findings.skillSays: const { user, error } = await supabase.auth.signIn({ email, password })
findings.trueNow: supabase-js v2 has no auth.signIn method, so this call fails. Sign in with a password using auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password }), which returns { data, error }.
findings.suggestedText: const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })
